messages:
olivia: Heads-up — noticed a sharp uptick in GPU provisioning latency starting ~00:20 UTC. Correlated with high iowait on scratch NVMe nodes in us-west1.

olivia: Example: queue depth spikes when janitor runs the deep-scrub job, causing new GPU pods to stall for minutes. :grimacing:

raj: ugh. did you see any SMART errors or firmware resets?

olivia: No SMART tripped, but scrub backlog went from ~30k objs to 180k in 10m. io.stat shows random 95th token latency for 4k IOs at 45ms on affected hosts.

emma: can we throttle janitor? last time we increased concurrency it helped but cost TC more.

infra-bot: Janitor scheduling window: 00:00-04:00 UTC. Current concurrency: 32. Average iops per node during window: 14800.

miguel: quick mitigation: reduce janitor concurrency to 8 for us-west1 and enable scratch read-prefetch to lower small-read latency. rollout in 5m?

raj: agree. also add a short-term routing rule to prefer eu-west nodes for GPU provisioning if us-west1 latency > 30ms for > 2m. fallback to us-west if capacity < 10%.

jonathan: creating a canary policy now. patch to routing service: 
```
if region == "us-west1" and nvme_iowait_p95 > 30ms:
  prefer alternative_region("eu-west1")
  max_offload = 0.15
```
will push to canary (2 hosts) and observe.

emma: +1. also log token-level cost on redirected requests so we can see egress and higher tail latencies.

olivia: rolling concurrency change to janitor: `kubectl patch configmap janitor-config -p '{"concurrency":8}'` on staging then prod after 10m.

miguel: FYI, this reduces deep scrub throughput but should shave peak IOPS by ~60%. we should schedule a targeted compaction for the hot shards after scrub finishes to avoid reaccumulation.

raj: long term: we need smarter janitor backoff that considers downstream GPU attach QPS and recent provision failures. Filing a short RFC?

olivia: please file — include metrics to surface (provision_attach_failures, nvme_iowait_p95, janitor_backlog_count).

jonathan: RFC filed: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/2026/janitor-backoff. Added initial design + simulation numbers.

emma: monitoring tasks: add dashboard panels for scratchpool iowait by region, and alert if provisioning latency > 20s for 3m.

infra-bot: Action items recorded: reduce-janitor-concurrency(us-west1), canary-routing-rule, add-dashboard-panels.

olivia: thanks all. will watch canary and post updates. :thumbsup:
